records.subject: Mg2Si0.75Sn0.25
records.quote: By means of Density Functional Theory (DFT) study, we have performed the structural, electronic, optical and thermoelectric properties calculations of tin doped Mg2Si (Mg2Si1-xSnx, x = 0, 0.125, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.875, 1) using Full Potential Linearized Augmented Plane Wave (FP-LAPW) Method.
context_quotes: With semiclassical Boltzmann transport theory, the transport properties of Mg2Si and Sn doped Mg2Si alloys has been investigated systematically.
The thermoelectric properties have been calculated for the temperature range 100 K to 800 K.

Out of the five studied materials, Mg2Si0.75Sn0.25 found to be a better thermoelectric material with increased Power factor, Seebeck coefficient, electrical conductivity and corresponding thermal conductivity at high temperature range.

records.quote: FESEM and FETEM images revealed that ionic liquid is well confined in the PEGDMA scaffold.
modality_evidence: FESEM and FETEM images revealed that ionic liquid is well confined in the PEGDMA scaffold.
records.conditions: FESEM and FETEM images

records.subject: FESEM
records.quote: Chemically cross-linked ionogels were prepared by the immobilization of ionic liquid, 1-butyl-3-methyl imidazolium tetrafluoroborate (BMIMBF4) in polyethylene glycol dimethacrylate (PEGDMA) matrix using azobisisobutyronitrile (AIBN) as the free radical initiator.
context_quotes: Thermal stability, glass transition temperature (T-g), Surface morphology, microstructure, the crystallinity of IGs and nature of chemical interaction between the ionic liquid and polymer matrix were observed by performing TGA, DSC, FESEM, FETEM, XRD, and FTIR respectively.
modality_evidence: Thermal stability, glass transition temperature (T-g), Surface morphology, microstructure, the crystallinity of IGs and nature of chemical interaction between the ionic liquid and polymer matrix were observed by performing TGA, DSC, FESEM, FETEM, XRD, and FTIR respectively.
